requirement.title: Миграция репозитория
requirement.contract: Согласовать исходный/целевой repo, цель transfer/rename/copy/cross-host, сохраняемые свойства и метод. Сравнить native transfer и import/mirror. Инвентарь refs/history/LFS/metadata/rights/protections/apps/hooks/runners/automation/docs по применимости. Проверить URL-формы, корректные старые имена и историю. Host-specific редиректы/возможности проверять по текущим данным. Нет автоматического удаления/перезаписи/расширения доступов. Проверить существенные свойства/интеграции; production и secrets отдельно.

historical_lookup_reason: Current request explicitly refers to approved map; only topic13 read to reconcile its contract, not a review of closed requests. Contract matches current request.

cases.native-transfer: same identity/properties, real temporary bare refs/history + LFS fixture, exact authorized current-consumer/remote changes, shared preoperation reads
cases.links-only: all5 URL forms, correct old service/email/history, actual check scope and gaps
cases.same-host-plan: current native transfer versus copy/import/mirror; metadata/identity and capabilities
cases.copy-plan: independent cross-host goal, missing provider/settings and separate metadata/integration migration
cases.receiver-blocked: nonempty/incompatible receiving account; no deletion/visibility downgrade/grants
cases.mirror-risk: actual source/destination refs; destination-only protected history/ref preserved; no mirror push
cases.redirect-reuse: current observed broken redirect; no eternal-redirect inference from diff
cases.access-denied: no other access channel/grants/credentials; verified facts and missing scope
cases.unrelated: 184; no subject bodies, API or mutations

limits: Real provider operations, Git LFS client protocol, hook delivery, real CI job, credential/deploy-key and production verification are not claimed. Synthetic API state and public safe integration/real bare Git operations have exact assertions.
